Context: 4. Items of 'Fees' subject to payment of share to Government-

- Income received from regular remunerative occupation in the nature of part-time employment, with permission under Rule 15
- (iv) of Conduct Rules; and
- (v) Income received for exploitation of a patent taken out without permission.
